# Playground

This is a blank Java 25 project for trying out ideas during the workshop. It
deliberately has no concurrency lesson, learning objectives, or prescribed
outcome. Add and change code here freely without altering the focused examples
used for teaching.

---

## Prerequisite

Install an
[Oracle Java 25](https://www.oracle.com/java/technologies/downloads/#java25)
JDK or newer and ensure `java` and `javac` resolve to it in the terminal.

## Getting started

Run these commands from this example directory. Choose one of the following ways
to run the example.

1. Run the example using the
   [Maven `exec` plugin](https://www.mojohaus.org/exec-maven-plugin/).

   ```shell
   ./mvnw clean compile exec:exec
   ```

   One possible run; thread ordering will vary.

   ```
   ...
   [12:34:56.789] [                                          Thread[#3,main,5,main]] Playground
   [12:34:56.795] [                                          Thread[#3,main,5,main]] Using Java 25.0.5.0.3
   [12:34:56.796] [                                          Thread[#3,main,5,main]] Done
   ...
   ```

2. Build the application and create the JAR file.

   ```shell
   ./mvnw clean package
   ```

   (*Optional*) List the created JAR file.

   ```shell
   tree --dirsfirst --sort=name './target/libs'
   ```

   The application JAR file

   ```
   ./target/libs
   └── playground-1.0.0.jar

   1 directory, 1 file
   ```

   Run the application.

   ```shell
   java \
     --module-path './target/libs' \
     --module demo
   ```

   One possible run; thread ordering will vary.

   ```
   [12:35:00.020] [                                          Thread[#3,main,5,main]] Playground
   [12:35:00.025] [                                          Thread[#3,main,5,main]] Using Java 25.0.5.0.3
   [12:35:00.025] [                                          Thread[#3,main,5,main]] Done
   ```
